title: Project Engagement Points on Network and Server Order Cancellation Fees
content:
**Schedule.** Project points come off the infrastructure fee percentage, the fee percentage charged on a Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order cancelled after its purchase order, when the client holds one or more Professional Services Projects engagements whose status is in progress, the largest class among them deciding:

- **2.0 points** when any of them is classed Standard Project, Advanced Project, Major Project or Strategic Program;
- **1.0 point** when every one of them is of a smaller class, that is Assessment Engagement or Quick Start Project;
- none without an in-progress engagement.

The class and status are read from the client's project engagement records; an engagement in any status other than in progress does not count.

| In-progress engagements held | Points off the fee percentage |
|---|---|
| one Major Project | 2.0 |
| one Quick Start Project and one Standard Project | 2.0 (the larger class decides) |
| two Assessment Engagements | 1.0 |
| one Quick Start Project | 1.0 |
| none in progress (a Strategic Program no longer in progress does not count) | none |

Points are percentage points: a fee percentage of 12.0 less 2.0 points is 10.0.
